prompt:
Analyze the following customer support inquiry. Classify severity into {routine, frustrated, severe}.
Return JSON with 'severity' and 'reason'.

INQUIRY: "@AppleSupport I have an iPhone 7 running 11.1.2 with massive battery issue (battery was fine on 10.x). In 1h28m of use (mostly Safari, no video), I have dropped 25%. See attached. Could it have anything to do with brand new Apple watch 3 with cellular? https://t.co/BvXwHL2vqF"
Output JSON: {"severity": "<routine|frustrated|severe>", "reason": "<one_line_explanation>"}
response: {"severity": "severe", "reason": "High-risk severity, destructive issue, or extreme distress detected."}
